frozen_analysis.identity_claim: Same returned API identifier only; serving weight snapshots are not attested.
limitations: Patch quality and generation style confound own-output preference; this is not causal self-recognition or self-bias.
Execution strata are benchmark outcomes, not human preference labels.
Judges inspect full issues and patches without source execution or hidden checks.
The small fixed task sample does not estimate a population of repositories.
Model aliases may route to changing serving weights.

uncertainty.coverage_rule: No bootstrap interval for an incomplete matched family grid. Report selected, eligible, attempted, valid and matched task counts for every estimand and stratum.
uncertainty.degenerate_rule: Withhold bootstrap intervals for constant family means, zero-width bootstrap quantiles, fewer than20 families or insufficient tail resamples. A separately labelled bounded sensitivity may be shown under declared independent-family assumptions; never substitute it silently for a bootstrap interval.
uncertainty.role: All own-identifier, third-judge and execution-stratum intervals are exploratory; no significance or simultaneous-coverage claim.
uncertainty.stratum_rule: Twenty selected tasks do not imply twenty eligible tasks in a stratum. Each stratum independently requires at least20 observed task families.

interpretation: All84 available judgments completed once; all276 unavailable scheduled cells remain visible.
Overall matched subsets contain6 task families for Luna,6 for Terra and4 for Sol; these are not a common-cohort ranking.
The comparator is the judge model that generated neither patch, not neutral ground truth or an independent human label.

All54 bootstrap confidence intervals are withheld. Twelve predeclared small-stratum Hoeffding sensitivity ranges remain separately labelled and conditional on independence; they do not establish self-bias.
